title: Untrusted-origin content is marked at ingest
notes: and can never travel unmarked into an agent's context.
- Decision: Codex adjudication chose role/provider tagging over an `origin`
schema column (high confidence; a column would cost hours of re-embed per
machine or migration logic the disposable-index design avoids). Brief and
result: `ingest-notes --third-party` stamps records with role `source` (kept out of `SEMANTIC_ROLES`, so never embedded and never in semantic fusion); recall serves synthesis only, so no session-start injection; `Hit` now carries `role` through every lane, and search output prints `UNTRUSTED THIRD-PARTY TEXT` on source hits. Boundary documented in AGENTS.md as a hard rule. Third-party content is not ingested today (brain's `sources/`, 10,934 files, is excluded); this closes the path in advance of it. No schema change, no index rebuild.
